title: Referral Program | Teal Update
description:
Instead of investing in big ads through Google or Facebook, we want to invest in you.

Why?

Because we believe in you. And that’s the idea behind Teal Referrals: to empower you when you share the benefits of Teal with your network.
For every 5 people who sign up using your referral link, you’ll receive a week of Teal+. 

So now, not only are you spreading the word about Teal, but in doing so, you’ll be that much closer to landing your dream job with Teal+

How it works:
Hit the gift icon on the sidebar and share your personalized link with your network. You’ll receive a $9 credit when 5 people you invite successfully complete their free Teal sign-up. You can redeem this credit any time to get 1 week of Teal+ for free or apply it to an existing subscription.

Teal will always be a FREE platform for job seekers, our Teal+ subscription allows you to unlock unlimited AI generation as well as a comprehensive list for Matching Mode analysis to help you tailor your resumes more efficiently. 

Check out more at tealhq.com
